lines.text: Jesus tells His disciples to be dressed for service and keep their lamps burning, like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet.
The master finds his servants on watch and dresses himself to serve, and he waits on them at the table.
Jesus says the Son of Man will come at an unexpected hour, and John asks whether the parable is for them or for everyone.
The faithful manager gives the servants their portion at the proper time, and the master puts him in charge of all his possessions.
The master of the unfaithful servant comes on an unexpected day and assigns him a place with the unbelievers, and the servant who knew his master's will is beaten with few blows.
